### [An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/26/relay-market/#atom-everything)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-07-26

A market exists for reselling LLM tokens at a discount, primarily in China, using pooled API keys obtained through various exploits, raising concerns about LLM application abuse.

- Token resellers offer discounted LLM access by pooling API keys from free trials, unprotected support bots, stolen credit cards, or chargeback attacks.
- The primary software used for these proxy services is open-source, specifically "one-api" and its fork "new-api", which are legitimate API proxy products.
- Buyers seek cheap tokens, geo-restriction avoidance, and data for model distillation.
- The market is largely concentrated in China, as indicated by the principal source being a Chinese-language forum thread.

**Why it matters:** The existence of this market increases the risk of abuse for publicly exposed LLM-driven applications, necessitating better API key capping mechanisms from LLM vendors.
